Travel paperwork, helpful news after dinner
We write to travelers

Travel paperwork and animal care notice

Travelers should confirm that all companion animal travel papers are in order before arrival at the airport. This notice explains what the Companion Animal Travel Desk of Aurelia Skyways will review and how our staff will support a calm handover for pets.

Our handlers use calm, humane methods around animals, and a welfare coordinator checks comfort needs with care. <<FACT F001>> If you are concerned about your pet, please speak up at once; supervisors will listen carefully and help resolve the matter with steady attention. We ask travelers to keep carriers secure, labels clear, and documents ready so the process remains smooth for all involved.

If you are traveling with Bowie or another companion animal, our desk will guide you through the final checks and direct you to the right counter. Please visit the Companion Animal Travel Desk for assistance before boarding.
